Definition: a palanquin or canopy (as a fixture); also a species of lizard (probably as clinging fast)
BiblicalUsage: tsâb means a covered wagon or litter; a lizard. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including Leviticus 11:29, Numbers 7:3, and Isaiah 66:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâb shows how carefully God chose His words, and this one earns its place.
